title: The frontier is opening!
author: LimesMustBurnDev
selftext:
After a lot of work, I'm getting closer to opening the first public playtest of *Limes Must Burn*!

Set along the Roman frontier around AD 259-260, the game lets you explore the Agri Decumates, build settlements, recruit warriors, develop your character, and deal with the Romans and the various Germanic tribes living beyond the frontier.

There's still a lot to improve, and that's where you come in!

I'm looking forward to having new players try the game, explore its world, and share their thoughts. Whether you find bugs, have suggestions, or simply tell me what you enjoyed (or didn't enjoy), your feedback will be a big help.

Public playtest coming soon!
